_comment: The lab Go2 as deployed on 2026-08-27. Derived from run-profile.example.json, with
three deliberate differences, each of which is a measurement rather than a taste:
1. Every path points at /home/unitree/mappo-stamped, which is commit aa12354 of main
deployed by deploy/push-to-robot.sh and verified in place. Its tree id resolves, so
a run from it can name its own commit. ~/mappo-main cannot: 46 files differing
across 21 commits and 217 tracked files absent.
2. heading_servo_flag is 'modern'. Checked against THAT tree rather than this
repository: mappo_drive.py:1000 defines --heading-servo with default 'off', and
line 1013 keeps --no-heading-servo as a hidden store_const alias for 'off'. Both
spellings parse; the new one is sent.
3. launch_prefix authenticates by key. No password appears here, and BatchMode=yes
makes ssh fail fast rather than hang on a prompt no operator can see.
record stays false. The on-robot recorder sits on the control thread and takes the
new-result tick from 100.6 ms to 246.4 ms -- issue #18, and half of issue #25's goal
overrun. Capture frames from the frame server on :8801 instead; it is a separate
process that is already reading the camera and costs the control loop nothing.
label: lab Go2 (mappo-stamped, aa12354)
